title: Base corpus: chest pain, 22 chunks
description: The frozen chest-pain corpus and its sqlite-vec index, as the retrieval layer builds them. citations.csv is the key registry the citation guard validates against.

license.name: Public domain (US federal government works)
license.note: Every source is a US government work. Publisher, URL, retrieval date and licence status per source are derived from citations.csv at build time.

corpus.note: Queries must be embedded with the same model. Reading the vectors needs the sqlite-vec extension; the embedder is not in this pack.
